title: About the project
project: SIMO: An Online Tool to Support the Teaching of Optimization
intro: Research in the field of optimization that resulted in a paper presented at the Brazilian Symposium on Operations Research (SBPO) in 2016. This modern version runs entirely in the browser, with no server, and can be installed as an app (PWA) and used offline.

advisor.title: Advisor
advisor.text: Professor André Oliveira da Cruz, M.Sc.

authors.title: Authors
authors.thanks: Thanks to the collaborators: without them this work would not have been possible.
